verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is documented as a serverless cloud data warehouse with "no infrastructure to manage," and the evidence shows no self-hostable deployment of the MotherDuck service itself. The nearby items do not count toward this story: the local MCP server is a client-side tool, enterprise support covers on-premise DuckDB (a different product), and local DuckDB development is a workaround rather than self-hosting MotherDuck.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
